messages:
josh (AE): Quick ask — founders-stage fintech (Seed, YC S20) wants an extended trial + promo credits to run a 6-week POC on Dedicated. They asked for $30k in credits + 3 months Dedicated access. POC: fraud scoring, peak ~600 req/s, persistent KV cache. CC @sam (RevOps) @micaela (SalesOps) @anya (Solutions)

sam (RevOps): Can you share ARR or expected contract size post-POC? We usually cap promo credits for founders program. Alternative: smaller credit + commit discount.

micaela (SalesOps): Heads up — Founders promo rules: revenue < $1M, one-time promo <= $15kUSD by default. Anything >15k needs Deal Desk + Finance sign-off. Also need the account billing entity.

anya (Solutions): Also flag: security questionnaire is still pending. If they need Private deployment for data, that changes cost/ops. I can run a light security review (3 business days) if you send contact + sample data types.

cecilia (Finance): For promos > $10k we need documented business case and GL coding. If we approve $30k we need CFO approval and to tag as marketing/promotions expense. Is there an NDA or MSA already signed?

josh (AE): They signed a mutual NDA last week (attached in thread). Customer contact: sara@finfounder.io. Expected decision date: ~6 weeks. They indicated potential first-year commit ~$50k ARR if POC succeeds.

micaela (SalesOps): Ok — looks like Deal Desk path. @sam can we consider a middle ground? Also need start date for trial and exact resources (GPU type, nodes).

sam (RevOps): Proposal from RevOps: provisional approval for a compromise package: 15k credits + 60 days Dedicated access. Offer 30% off year-1 if they sign a commit >= $50k within 90 days of trial end. Condition: attach POC plan + timeline + signed commitment trigger. If customer insists on $30k upfront, need Finance + Legal exec sign-off.

legal-bot: Quick template for Deal Desk terms (attach to ticket):
```
PromoException:
  credits: 15000
  dedicated_days: 60
  commit_discount: 30%
  commit_threshold_usd: 50000
  commit_window_days: 90
  conditions: signed commitment + POC acceptance criteria
```

cecilia (Finance): That template looks fine as long as Revenue Ops documents expected uplift and cost center. I'll pre-approve up to $15k as promo spend. Anything above requires VP Finance sign-off.

anya (Solutions): I can turn around the security checklist in 3 business days and confirm whether Dedicated is sufficient or Private required. If Private is needed, we'll have to re-evaluate capacity timing.

sam (RevOps): RevOps provisional sign-off given the 15k/60d/30% structure. I'll open the Deal Desk ticket and mark as "Founders exception - provisional". @micaela please file the ticket with: NDA, POC plan, timeline, contact, cost center. I'll escalate to Finance if they request the full $30k. :white_check_mark:

josh (AE): Thanks — I'll update the customer with the compromise offer and get the POC plan into the ticket. Will attach NDA + sample data schema. Appreciate the quick responses.

micaela (SalesOps): Filing ticket now. ETA ticket ID DEAL-2026-1127. Attaching josh's POC doc and the NDA.

sam (RevOps): I'll monitor. If customer pushes for $30k before commit, ping me and I'll route to VP Finance.

josh (AE): Will do. Closing loop here — will post updates in the ticket thread. :raised_hands:
